name: lw_12465
statement: (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z) : (Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + 1 / (x ^ 2)) + Real.sqrt (y ^ 2 + 1 / (y ^ 2)) + Real.sqrt (z ^ 2 + 1 / (z ^ 2))) ≥ Real.sqrt 82
closed: ∀ (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z), (Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + 1 / (x ^ 2)) + Real.sqrt (y ^ 2 + 1 / (y ^ 2)) + Real.sqrt (z ^ 2 + 1 / (z ^ 2))) ≥ Real.sqrt 82
informal: Prove that for positive reals $x$, $y$, and $z$, the following inequality holds: $\sqrt {x^2 + \frac{1}{{x^2 }}} + \sqrt {y^2 + \frac{1}{{y^2 }}} + \sqrt {z^2 + \frac{1}{{z^2 }}} \geq \sqrt{82}$
